## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`npm test --workspace=services/<name>` or `npm run test --workspace=@eduelderly/client`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Accessibility checked for any UI change (keyboard, 44px targets, contrast, labels)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `.env.example`, OpenAPI annotations) if behaviour or config changed
